title: Common providers: Vietnam
coverage: Partial. Covers the three large carriers, the mobile network operators, two cable operators, three business ISPs and the research network; names are as the providers write them, without the long Vietnamese company names.
missing: Full Vietnamese company names (none was confirmed against a source that may be copied)
The regulator's operator register (the telecommunications authority's site did not answer on the read date)
Smaller ISPs and regional cable operators
Websites for VNPT, VTVcab and VinaREN (none answered an automated check on the read date)
Status pages (none was found that answered a check)

sources.name: Ministry of Science and Technology (the ministry that regulates telecommunications)
sources.terms: The site shows a copyright notice in Vietnamese and no reuse licence was found on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date; the telecommunications authority's own site did not. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: VNNIC (Vietnam Internet Network Information Center)
sources.terms: The site shows a copyright notice and no reuse licence was found on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the national registry to consult for an AS number.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Vietnam and Telecommunications in Vietnam
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 6 of 11 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 11 websites and 1 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 18 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: Viettel
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. The second address is the retail site.

providers.name: VNPT
providers.notes: Fixed, and mobile as VinaPhone. Its websites did not answer an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: MobiFone
providers.notes: AS45896 is registered to MobiFone Global.

providers.name: VTVcab
providers.notes: Cable. Its website refused an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: VinaREN
providers.notes: The AS number is registered to the National Agency for Scientific and Technological Information. No website answered.
